shows.title: Houdini & Magic / Lizzie Borden Case
shows.first_half: First Half: President of Potter & Potter Auctions, Gabe Fajuri will discuss the legacy of Harry Houdini, the mysteries surrounding his death, and Houdini’s influence on the world of magic. He'll also preview the special anniversary auction at the Magic Castle in Hollywood on Halloween, featuring Houdini-related artifacts.
shows.second_half: Second Half: C2C's investigative reporter Cheryll Jones presents her recorded interview with former homicide detective Jason White exploring the infamous 1892 Lizzie Borden case, in which Borden was accused of the axe murders of her father and stepmother. Jason will join George and Cheryll live during the final hour.

shows.title: Paranormal Strangeness / Ghost-to-Ghost 2026
shows.first_half: Paranormal investigator, author, and podcast host Joshua P. Warren will discuss new strategies for dealing with paranormal entities and reveal why Halloween has long been considered a unique time for heightened supernatural activity. Exploring the mysteries of interdimensional portals, energy anomalies, and spirit encounters, Warren will offer guidance for navigating paranormal phenomena. Then, join us for our annual Ghost-to-Ghost show and call in with your scariest, creepiest ghost story.
